Header: Pestalotiopsis psidii Sinhala - Pera kabolu Rogaya; Tamil – Koiya porukku noi

Prevention: Remove excess and damaged branches after harvesting
Cover fruits with paper or polythene bags with one side open end at small stage
Helopeltis bugs to reduce the initiation of the disease
Monitoring: Observe brownish- blackish colour pustules on fruits
Direct Control: Use neem seed kernel extract (50g/l of water) to control
Restrictions: Rate of dilution 30ml/ 10 lit. of water.
Toxic to predatory mites, fish and earthworms
Rate of dilution 20g/ 10 lit. of water.
Toxic to parasitoids and fish and moderately toxic to predatory mites
